name: Daraja
intro: The Daraja front door lists all the apps on shelves. You will pick your shelf, give your name, open three apps right inside the front door and come back each time, and check it remembers you.

steps.do: The page says “Daraja — your family of apps, one front door” and asks which shelf is yours. Tap “🏠 Your household”.
steps.see: A small box asks “And what should I call you?” with a place to type, Cancel and OK.

steps.do: Type this name (keep the apostrophe) and tap “OK”.
steps.see: A green card greets you by name — “…, Margaret O'Brien. Your shelf is ready.” — and says “The green ones are the ones you already use.” Below it, “☀️ What would you like to do?” has six big tiles, like “🍽 Plan a meal” and “🙋 Ask the family something”.

steps.do: Scroll down to the “🏠 Your household” shelf.
steps.see: App cards including 🌱 Every Day, 🍽 Our Table, 🙋 Who’s Coming and 🧭 One Thing, each saying “try it · free while testing”.
Every Day opens right inside the page, with a dark strip across the top: “‹ Daraja”, “🌱 Every Day” and “open on its own ↗”. Every Day’s own welcome card shows.
steps.tip: Don’t do the Every Day tour now — we are only checking that it opens.

steps.do: Tap “‹ Daraja” in the top-left corner.
steps.see: You are back at the front door. The green card now says “Every Day: 6 cards left” and has a “Turn a card” button.

steps.do: Scroll down to the “🏠 Your household” shelf again.
steps.see: The Every Day card now says “you use this”; Our Table still says “try it · free while testing”.

steps.do: Scroll back up and tap the “🍽 Plan a meal” tile.
steps.see: Our Table opens inside the page; the dark strip at the top says “🍽 Our Table”.
Back at the front door, with the “☀️ What would you like to do?” tiles.

steps.do: Tap the “🙋 Ask the family something” tile.
steps.see: Who’s Coming opens inside the page; the strip at the top says “🙋 Who’s Coming”.
Back at the front door again.

steps.do: At the top, in the green card, tap “Turn a card”.
steps.see: Every Day opens inside the page again (“🌱 Every Day” in the top strip).

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: The front door opens with the green card still greeting Margaret O'Brien. It does not ask your name again.

steps.do: Scroll down to the “🏠 Your household” shelf.
steps.see: Every Day, Our Table and Who’s Coming all say “you use this” and sit at the front of the shelf; One Thing still says “try it”. The front door remembers what you opened today.
